visualCharacteristics.purpose: Expandable FAQ list of question/answer rows
visualCharacteristics.description: Rows separated by 1px #e5e5e5 lines (above each row and after the last). Each row: 20px/500 navy question on the left, 20px blue plus icon on the right that rotates into a minus when open; answer revealed below. Native details/summary. Section heading stays as default content above the block.

contentPattern.description: FAQ Heading with 4 placeholder rows titled 'FAQ Title'; the Figma has no answers, placeholder answers are authored.
contentPattern.structure: container block, one row per question; cells: summary (text: question) | text (richtext: answer)

usage: FAQ section at the end of a blog article.
reuseGuidance: Keep the FAQ section heading as default content above the block. Author one row per question; the answer may contain paragraphs, lists and links.
